title: Gemini in Google Drive

body.text: Gemini in Google Drive helps you
search files with natural language and summarize file contents directly
, without opening files one by one — making it much faster to manage lots of documents.

example: "Find files about 'vendor contracts' created last month."

title: Summarize Drive files with AI

body.text: click a file in Drive and have Gemini summarize the key content in seconds
, so you know what a file is about before deciding to open and read it all — a big time-saver.

example: "[Select a file in Drive] Summarize this file: give the main points and conclusion."

question: How does Gemini in Google Drive help you search files?

options.text: It can only search by filename
Search with natural language — by topic or time period
It can only search files shared with others

question: What's the benefit of summarizing files in Drive?

options.text: Knowing a file's main content without reading all of it

question: Which is an example of using Gemini with Google Drive?

options.text: Asking 'Create a new spreadsheet for me'
Asking 'Find the 2024 budget file I created'
Asking 'Delete all files in this folder'

question: You have lots of files in Google Drive and want the gist of one quickly. What should you do?

options.text: Have Gemini summarize that file in Drive
Download and read all of it first

question: Before having AI summarize a confidential work file, what should you be careful about?

options.text: Check that it's data allowed to be shared/processed under policy
